notes.title: Roody:2d 0.10.0 beta pre-release 6
notes.notes:
[h2]World Generation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Snow Biome
[list]
[*]Pine Trees
[*]Snow
[*]Icy lakes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/d3005ea146473ec7ffa54eb889b81f3b7ab85b95.png[/img]
[*]Tree planting is more varied
[/list]

[h2]New Blocks[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Snow[/b] - Crushable like grass. When 4 of them stack, it turns into ice. Can be extracted from ice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/c0a6baee75faf71830e709156ff9ab3ce6aee393.gif[/img]
[*]The existing "log" and "leaf" are now "maple log" and "maple leaf"
[*][b]Pine Log[/b] and [b]Pine Leaf[/b] - grows straighter than maple trees. Found in snowy biomes. Only pine trees can grow when covered in snow.
[*][b]Sawdust[/b] - extracted from pine logs
[*][b]Prism[/b] - reflects different colors of beam in different directions. This makes beam splitting and merging possible

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/f486a04f40100f14aa9fec2451e13a8f12154698.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Block Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed beam shader
[*]Yellow, Cyan, and Magenta beams now have unique effects
[*]Blue beams now kill grassy dirt and turn small plants into snow
[*]Grassy dirt now has 2 variations and dirt fertility has been overhauled
[*]Platforms update instantly when welded or unwelded
[*]Frames and frame styled blocks (wires, togglers, detectors, etc) are slightly fancier. Note the lack of a dot grid in the middle of all these frames
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/3cf798b45b0c2f08771a3c660fcd03a0b35089b4.png[/img]
[*]Catalyst Core now shows what blocks it is catalyzing
[*]Magnet can now be catalyzed (missing from earlier patch notes)
[*]Injector can now be catalyzed to increase range
[*]Various texture changes, especially mantler and transistor
[/list]

[h2]Recipe Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Injector recipes now use sawdust instead of maple logs
[*]Beam core recipe now uses a lamp instead of a force core
[*]Telecross's recipe now has aligned raw cores and needs a calcium bar
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]Mouse hovering over various blocks with ranges displays that range, such as the injector vs. a catalyzed injector
[*]Beams now show in the WAILA when mouse hovering air
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Various changes to update order
[*]Fixed collectors getting smooshed
[*]Detectors should be more consistent
[*]Recording gifs now create a single pallet for the entire game, instead of per-frame. This reduces jitter in gifs, but generally lowers the number of colors able to be displayed. Fullbright is now an option for gifs.
[*]Fixed catalyzed chairs not acting the same as catalyzed pilot chairs
[*]Generating a large dungeon no longer flashes the screen
[/list]

notes.title: Roody:2d 0.10.0 beta pre-release 5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Bushberts can burrow out of a block on any side, instead of just the top
[*]Clusters of powered rollers should no longer be able to get stuck powered on
[*]Fixed the UI scale slider
[*]When already loaded in a world, the "load_world" command, when run with no arguments, will load the last save of the current world.
[*]The "purge" command now has an optional radius that will only kill entities within that distance from the mouse
[*]New texture for raw cores
[/list]

notes.title: Roody:2d 0.10.0 beta pre-release 4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Hovering over a block in the guidebook will highlight that type of block in the backpack
[*]The player character will turn to face mouse actions
[*]Camera jitter reduced when zoomed out
[*]Roody:2d no longer takes 100% of a CPU core unnecessarily 
[/list]

notes.title: Roody:2d 0.10.0 beta pre-release 3
notes.notes:
[h2]New Blocks[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Counter[/b] - Counts pulses. Adjustable and resetable.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/524b4aa9e099b0b7b38b5963b8bc158b2e16dacb.gif[/img]

[h2]Block Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Rollers and dynamic rollers now get powered together when welded together. Rollers can no longer be welded to dynamic rollers
[*]Teleporting a chair will also carry a player sitting in the chair
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added camera damping. Can be adjusted or disabled in the options menu
[*]Options menu organized into sub-menus
[*]Added hover-text for guidebook catagories and research tree
[*]Reorginized guidebook catagories
[*]Mouse hovering over a spawner shows its range
[*]Many tweaks to guidebook and WAILA (What Am I Looking At)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Locking a hotbar slot now saves and loads correctly
[*]Sensor now updates sensing solid or charge on the side of beams
[*]Fixed inductor recipe example in guidebook being impossible
[*]Syncronized the mouse radiuses for hover-over displays and being able to adjust
[*]Fixed some corruptions and crashes with text entry
[/list]

notes.title: Roody:2d 0.10.0 beta pre-release 2
notes.notes:
[h2]New Blocks[/h2]
[list]
[*]The [b]pedestal[/b] makes blocks available to be summoned
[*]The [b]summonore[/b] summons available blocks. Fueled by plant matter.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/63e37a443f40553fc9dba2929b77b7b0acdc2f3f.gif[/img]

[h2]Recipe Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Mass core now costs 2 raw cores, down from 4
[*]Catalyst Core now costs 2 refined core, down from 4
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added more details to guidebook
[*]Applicable encyclopedia tutorials have research disabled
[*]Using pick-block on a toggler no longer copies its on/off state
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]When blocks move, two things happen: the block moves, and blocks around it get added to the update que. When multiple blocks moved, these two actions are no longer collated. When they were collated previously, sometimes a block position would get queued to update and then the block would move away, causing the block to not get updated.
In summary: moving blocks no longer forget to act.
[/list]
